strings.exam.theory.validity: A pass in the theory test is valid for 2 years from the date it is obtained (para. 23 of the Examination Rules, 2026 edition). After three failed attempts at the practical test, the theory result is cancelled ⟦1⟧.
strings.exam.theory.notes.0: The test has 40 questions. Each has several answer options and only one is correct ⟦2⟧.
strings.exam.theory.notes.1: You have 40 minutes for all the questions. The computer keeps the time, and the test ends automatically when time runs out ⟦3⟧.
strings.exam.theory.notes.2: To pass, you must answer at least 32 questions correctly, that is, you can make no more than 8 mistakes ⟦4⟧.
strings.exam.theory.notes.3: You choose the language of the test: Kazakh, Russian or English ⟦5⟧. Foreigners who do not speak Kazakh or Russian may take the theory test with a qualified interpreter ⟦6⟧.
strings.exam.theory.notes.4: You can answer in any order: you can skip a difficult question and come back to it later ⟦7⟧.
strings.exam.theory.notes.5: Each answer is confirmed by pressing the same key again. This protects against pressing a key by accident ⟦8⟧.
strings.exam.theory.notes.6: The result and the correct answers are shown only after you have answered all the questions or when time runs out ⟦9⟧.
strings.exam.theory.notes.7: Biometric identification takes place before the test, and your identity is checked during and after the test as well. After identification, you have 3 minutes to take your seat ⟦10⟧.
strings.exam.theory.notes.8: If you are ill on the day of the test, tell the examiner: the test can be rescheduled ⟦11⟧.
strings.exam.theory.notes.9: Phones, headphones, cheat sheets, sharing materials and leaving the room are prohibited. For a violation, the test is stopped, you are marked “fail”, and you cannot retake it for at least 3 months ⟦12⟧.
strings.exam.theory.notes.10: The theory test comes first, then the practical test. If you have not passed the theory test, you will not be admitted to the practical test ⟦13⟧.
strings.exam.practical.where: At the automated test ground of the State Corporation “Government for Citizens” (specialised PSC), in an exam car fitted with sensors and video cameras ⟦14⟧. The exercises are performed one after another according to the diagram of the particular test ground.
strings.exam.practical.scoring: Scoring is done by an automatic system, with no staff involved, and the result cannot be changed ⟦15⟧. Mistakes earn penalty points, which are added up. Under the test ground methodology, 99 points or fewer is a “pass”; if you reach 100 points, the test is stopped immediately and you are marked “fail”.
strings.exam.practical.notes.0: The system monitors wheels touching lines, the stopping position, gear selection, speed, direction indicators and hazard warning lights, the seat belt, and the time taken to complete the exercises ⟦16⟧.
strings.exam.practical.notes.1: For category B, the Rules describe 12 exercise zones: Start, Stopping and moving off uphill, Crossing a pedestrian crossing, 90-degree turns, Snake, U-turn and parking, Parallel reverse parking, Crossing a controlled intersection, Crossing an uncontrolled level crossing, Acceleration lane, Emergency stop, Finish ⟦17⟧. The order is set by the diagram of the test ground, so look at the diagram of your own specialised PSC in advance.
strings.exam.practical.notes.2: Errors that mean an immediate fail under the test ground methodology: not moving off within 30 seconds after the “Start” command, and driving through an intersection or over the “Stop” line on a stop signal of the traffic lights.
strings.exam.practical.notes.3: Speed on the test ground is limited by signs (usually 20 km/h), and exceeding it is penalised.
strings.exam.practical.notes.4: The car has voice prompts in Kazakh and Russian, everything is recorded by 360-degree cameras, and the recordings are kept for at least 12 months ⟦18⟧.
strings.exam.practical.notes.5: You take the test in the State Corporation’s car, not your own. Ask your driving school for the parking reference points for the model used at your specialised PSC.
strings.exam.practical.notes.6: If you are sure that points were awarded by mistake: request the video recording from the test ground and from the car, and submit an appeal through e-Otinish. The State Corporation has stated that if a technical fault is confirmed, the result is cancelled and the test is rescheduled (media reports, September 2026).
strings.exam.retakes.0: After the first fail, the retake (of both the theory test and the practical test) is scheduled for the next working day ⟦19⟧.
strings.exam.retakes.1: After two failed attempts at the theory test, each following attempt is allowed no earlier than one month later ⟦20⟧.
strings.exam.retakes.2: After two failed attempts at the practical test, the next one is allowed no earlier than one month later ⟦21⟧.
strings.exam.retakes.3: After three failed attempts at the practical test, the theory result is cancelled, the attempt counter is reset, and you are admitted to the theory test no earlier than two months later ⟦22⟧.
strings.exam.retakes.4: A violation during the theory test (prompting, phone, leaving the room) means “fail” and a retake no earlier than 3 months later ⟦23⟧.
strings.exam.retakes.5: If biometric identification did not confirm your identity when you applied, you are not admitted to the tests for 6 months ⟦24⟧.
strings.exam.retakes.6: You do not have to pay the state fee for a retake: it is charged only for issuing the licence (clarification from the State Corporation, May 2026).
strings.exam.retakes.7: The Examination Rules allow a retake on the next working day, but because of queues in some cities, free slots come much later. Book in advance.
strings.exam.retakes.8: Unlimited paid retakes at 10-day intervals have so far only been approved by the government (April 2026). They are not in the text of the Examination Rules (July 2026 edition), so the procedure described above applies.
strings.exam.steps.0.p: You can get a category B licence from the age of 18. You are admitted to the tests once you reach the age set by article 74 of the Road Traffic Act ⟦25⟧.
strings.exam.steps.1.p: You need a medical certificate of fitness to drive, Form No. 073/u ⟦26⟧. It is issued at a polyclinic. As a rule, the medical examination data are transferred electronically, and you do not need to bring a paper certificate to the specialised PSC.
strings.exam.steps.2.p: To be admitted to the tests, you need a certificate of completion of a course at a driver training organisation ⟦27⟧. You cannot learn to drive on the roads by yourself: learner driving on roads is allowed only with an instructor and after mastering the basic skills on a closed area (paras 146 and 147 of the Rules). The exceptions mentioned in the media are graduates of colleges and universities with a diploma in automotive and tractor engineering, and military personnel who trained in the army ⟦28⟧. If you belong to one of these groups, check the list of documents at the specialised PSC.
strings.exam.steps.3.p: Submit your application through the eGov portal, the eGov Mobile app or a PSC, or through an operator. Biometric identification is carried out when you apply ⟦29⟧. You choose the place, date and time of the test yourself from the available slots, at least one working day in advance ⟦30⟧.
strings.exam.steps.4.p: 40 questions, 40 minutes, at least 32 correct answers ⟦31⟧. Bring your ID and do not take your phone into the room. A pass is valid for 2 years ⟦32⟧.
strings.exam.steps.5.h: 6. Pass the practical test at the test ground
strings.exam.steps.5.p: The test takes place at the specialised PSC’s automated test ground, and the system scores it in penalty points ⟦33⟧. Under the test ground methodology, 100 penalty points means “fail”. You can take the practical test only after passing the theory test ⟦34⟧.
strings.exam.steps.6.h: 7. Pay the state fee and receive your licence
strings.exam.steps.6.p: The state fee for issuing a driving licence is 1.25 MCI (monthly calculation index; art. 667 of the Tax Code). In 2026 the MCI is 4 325 tenge, so the fee is about 5 406 tenge. It is paid online when you apply, and the tests are not paid for separately. The finished licence is issued in person at the centre you chose and is valid for 10 years ⟦35⟧.
strings.exam.changes2026.0.h: Transmission type is no longer shown on the licence
strings.exam.changes2026.0.date: Ministry of Internal Affairs Order No. 342 of 12.05.2026; according to lada.kz and noks.kz, from 25.05.2026; according to inbusiness.kz and el.kz, from 12.07.2026
strings.exam.changes2026.0.p: Information on the transmission type is not entered in the “Special notes” box of new licences: if you passed the test in an automatic car, you may also drive a manual one. According to media reports, for those who already have the note, it most likely stays valid until the licence is replaced; there is no official clarification on this.
strings.exam.changes2026.1.h: Theory test result is valid for 2 years
strings.exam.changes2026.1.date: 2026, Ministry of Internal Affairs Order No. 342 of 12.05.2026
strings.exam.changes2026.1.p: The State Corporation used to explain that no validity period was set for the theory result. Now para. 23 of the Examination Rules states that a pass in the theory test is valid for two years from the date it is obtained.
strings.exam.changes2026.2.h: New requirements for drivers under the law of 24.06.2026
strings.exam.changes2026.2.p: Drivers over 65 and people with disabilities must have a medical examination every two years, and without confirmation in the system their licence is suspended. Repeat offenders (dangerous manoeuvring, speeding, dangerous parking) may be sent to retake the theory test: if they do not pass within two months without a valid reason, the right to drive is terminated. If, after a crash while intoxicated, the criminal case is closed without a sentence (for example, on reconciliation of the parties), the right to drive is terminated; it can be regained no earlier than 8 years later, after a medical examination and a test on the Road Traffic Rules.
strings.exam.changes2026.3.h: Unlimited paid retakes and AI at tests
strings.exam.changes2026.3.status: announced, not yet added to the Examination Rules
strings.exam.changes2026.3.date: approved at a government meeting on 14.04.2026, no effective date given
strings.exam.changes2026.3.p: The plan: unlimited paid retakes with a break of at least 10 calendar days, monitoring of tests using artificial intelligence and computer vision, and suspension from the theory test for up to one year for attempting to cheat. The Ministry of Internal Affairs explained that one free retake every 30 days would remain, while paid retakes could be taken every 10 days. A pilot will start in Astana.
strings.exam.changes2026.4.h: Private test grounds and extended specialised PSC hours
strings.exam.changes2026.4.p: Because of queues of up to six months for tests, a Mazhilis deputy proposed accepting the practical test at driving school test grounds under uniform standards, extending specialised PSC working hours to 20:00, opening additional places for the theory test, and distributing slots only through eGov and eGov Mobile. According to the deputy, on 13.07.2026, 79 414 people were waiting for the theory test and 35 542 for the practical test.

strings.autodrom.0.name: Start
strings.autodrom.0.goal: Readiness to move: fasten your seat belt, signal, and move off without delay on command.
strings.autodrom.0.how.0: Before the command, adjust the seat, head restraint and all three mirrors.
strings.autodrom.0.how.1: Fasten your seat belt. While you are at it, locate the hazard warning button and the indicator stalk with your eyes.
strings.autodrom.0.how.2: Start the engine. In a manual car: neutral and clutch pressed down; in an automatic: foot on the brake.
strings.autodrom.0.how.3: Switch on the left direction indicator - this is the ready signal.
strings.autodrom.0.how.4: On the “Start” command, move off smoothly without hesitation.
strings.autodrom.0.how.5: Cross the start line with the left indicator on, and switch it off immediately after the line.
strings.autodrom.0.how.6: After that, keep your speed no higher than the sign allows.
strings.autodrom.0.penalties.1: Start line crossed without the left direction indicator - 5 penalty points.
strings.autodrom.0.penalties.2: Indicator not switched off immediately after the line - penalty under the test ground methodology.
strings.autodrom.0.penalties.3: Delay in starting after the command - penalty; not moving off within 30 seconds - fail.
strings.autodrom.0.tip: In a manual car, practise moving off at the clutch biting point in advance, so that you do not stall from nerves at the start.
strings.autodrom.1.name: Stopping and moving off uphill
strings.autodrom.1.goal: Stop on a slope in the designated zone and move off uphill without rolling back.
strings.autodrom.1.how.0: Drive onto the slope smoothly, without accelerating.
strings.autodrom.1.how.1: Stop so that the car is inside the exercise zone: past the zone start line and without going onto the “Stop” line.
strings.autodrom.1.how.2: Apply the handbrake or hold the brake pedal firmly.
strings.autodrom.1.how.4: Manual: select first gear, add a little throttle and release the clutch slowly until the car starts to “squat” slightly and vibrate. Then lower the handbrake smoothly and keep releasing the clutch.
strings.autodrom.1.how.5: Automatic: move your foot from the brake to the accelerator quickly but smoothly. If the car rolls back, move off using the handbrake, releasing it as you press the accelerator.
strings.autodrom.1.penalties.1: Stopping outside the zone: not reaching the zone start line or going onto the “Stop” line - penalty.
strings.autodrom.1.penalties.2: Moving off less than 3 seconds after stopping - penalty.
strings.autodrom.1.penalties.3: Taking too long to move off after stopping - penalty under the test ground methodology.
strings.autodrom.1.tip: Count to yourself “one and, two and, three and, four”: this way you will certainly stand for more than 3 seconds without dragging it out.
strings.autodrom.2.name: Crossing a pedestrian crossing
strings.autodrom.2.goal: Stop before the pedestrian crossing at the “Stop” line, wait, and continue.
strings.autodrom.2.how.0: When you see the “Pedestrian crossing” sign and the road markings, reduce speed in good time.
strings.autodrom.2.how.1: Stop before the “Stop” line: without touching it and no more than 1 m from it.
strings.autodrom.2.how.3: If the diagram requires a turn after the crossing, switch on the indicator in advance.
strings.autodrom.2.penalties.0: Touching or crossing the “Stop” line - 25 penalty points.
strings.autodrom.2.penalties.1: Stopping more than 1 m from the “Stop” line - penalty.
strings.autodrom.2.penalties.2: Moving off less than 3 seconds later - penalty.
strings.autodrom.2.tip: In practice, note where the “Stop” line appears relative to the bonnet or side mirror when you are less than a metre from it. This is your reference point.
strings.autodrom.3.name: 90-degree turns
strings.autodrom.3.goal: Drive through a narrow corridor with right-angle turns to the left and right without touching the control lines with your wheels.
strings.autodrom.3.how.0: Minimum speed. Manual: first gear with the clutch partly pressed; automatic: creeping at idle with light braking.
strings.autodrom.3.how.1: Before a turn, position yourself closer to the outer side of the corridor: before a right turn, closer to the left line; before a left turn, closer to the right.
strings.autodrom.3.how.2: Do not start the turn early. Turn the wheel when the front wheels are almost level with the corner of the turn: the rear wheels follow a shorter arc and cut the corner.
strings.autodrom.3.how.3: Turn the wheel quickly, but let the car move slowly.
strings.autodrom.3.how.4: Coming out of the turn, straighten the wheel in good time and look where you want to go.
strings.autodrom.3.how.5: Watch the rear wheels in the side mirrors.
strings.autodrom.3.penalties.0: A wheel touching a control line - 20 penalty points for each touch.
strings.autodrom.3.penalties.1: You have 2 minutes for the exercise; exceeding the time is penalised.
strings.autodrom.3.tip: The most common mistake is turning too early: then the rear wheel touches the inner line.
strings.autodrom.4.name: Snake
strings.autodrom.4.goal: Drive through a winding corridor with alternating turns without touching the lines.
strings.autodrom.4.how.0: Drive very slowly and evenly, without jerks or unnecessary stops.
strings.autodrom.4.how.1: Look not at the bonnet but at the next bend of the corridor.
strings.autodrom.4.how.2: Begin turning the wheel a little later than feels natural, so that the rear wheels do not cut the arc.
strings.autodrom.4.how.3: Once past the apex of the arc, start turning the wheel the other way in good time.
strings.autodrom.4.how.4: Check the distance from the rear wheels to the lines in the side mirrors.
strings.autodrom.4.penalties.0: A wheel touching a control line - 20 penalty points for each touch.
strings.autodrom.4.penalties.1: You have 2 minutes for the exercise; exceeding the time is penalised.
strings.autodrom.4.tip: Slow speed gives you time to correct the steering. Two minutes is more than enough, so there is no need to hurry.
strings.autodrom.5.name: U-turn and parking
strings.autodrom.5.goal: Turn round in a confined space and reverse into the parking space so that the rear wheels reach the fixing line.
strings.autodrom.5.how.0: Take a comfortable starting position for the turn without touching the lines.
strings.autodrom.5.how.1: Turn round. If there is little room, do it in several moves: forward, back, forward again.
strings.autodrom.5.how.2: Select reverse and move at the lowest speed, looking in both side mirrors and over your shoulder.
strings.autodrom.5.how.3: Start turning the wheel when the rear of the car is level with the near edge of the parking space.
strings.autodrom.5.how.4: Straighten the car parallel to the side lines of the space, comparing the distance to them in the left and right mirrors.
strings.autodrom.5.how.5: Reverse until the rear wheels reach or cross the fixing line, then stop.
strings.autodrom.5.penalties.0: Rear wheels not reaching the fixing line - penalty.
strings.autodrom.5.penalties.1: A wheel touching a control line - 20 penalty points for each touch.
strings.autodrom.5.penalties.2: You have 2 minutes for the exercise; exceeding the time is penalised.
strings.autodrom.5.tip: If you feel the car going crooked, stop, drive forward a little and straighten up. An extra move costs less than touching a line.
strings.autodrom.6.name: Parallel reverse parking
strings.autodrom.6.goal: Reverse into a space along the kerb, put the right wheels on the fixing line and drive out.
strings.autodrom.6.how.0: Stop parallel to the parking space, about 1 m from its boundary, so that the rear bumper is slightly beyond the rear boundary of the space.
strings.autodrom.6.how.1: Select reverse and move back slowly.
strings.autodrom.6.how.2: When the rear boundary of the space is roughly level with the rear wheel (look in the right mirror), turn the wheel to the right.
strings.autodrom.6.how.3: When the car has turned about 45 degrees to the kerb, straighten the wheels and continue reversing in a straight line.
strings.autodrom.6.how.4: When the right front corner of the car passes the front boundary of the space, turn the wheel to the left to “bring in” the front of the car.
strings.autodrom.6.how.5: As soon as the car is parallel to the kerb, straighten the wheels and stop. Check in the right mirror that the right wheels are on the fixing line.
strings.autodrom.6.how.6: Driving out: left indicator, wheel to the left and smoothly forward, without touching the lines.
strings.autodrom.6.penalties.0: Right wheels not placed on the fixing line - penalty.
strings.autodrom.6.penalties.1: A wheel touching a control line - 20 penalty points for each touch.
strings.autodrom.6.penalties.2: You have 2 minutes for the exercise; exceeding the time is penalised.
strings.autodrom.6.tip: The exact reference points depend on the car model. Find out at your driving school which cars are used for the test at your specialised PSC, and practise on a similar one.
strings.autodrom.7.name: Crossing a controlled intersection
strings.autodrom.7.goal: Drive through the intersection according to the traffic light signals: stop at the “Stop” line on a stop signal, proceed without delay on a go signal, and signal your turn.
strings.autodrom.7.how.0: As you approach, switch on the direction indicator in advance if your route requires a turn.
strings.autodrom.7.how.1: On a stop signal, stop before the “Stop” line, without touching it and without stopping too far back.
strings.autodrom.7.how.2: On a go signal, move off immediately and drive through the intersection without unnecessary stops.
strings.autodrom.7.how.3: When turning, watch your path and do not go beyond the lines.
strings.autodrom.7.how.4: After the manoeuvre, switch the indicator off.
strings.autodrom.7.penalties.0: Driving through the intersection or crossing the “Stop” line on a stop signal - fail.
strings.autodrom.7.penalties.1: Taking too long to drive through on a go signal - penalty, and with a long delay, fail (under the test ground methodology).
strings.autodrom.7.penalties.2: Direction indicator not switched on when turning - penalty.
strings.autodrom.7.penalties.3: Stopping too far from the “Stop” line (under the test ground methodology, more than 1 m) - penalty.
strings.autodrom.7.tip: If the green light has been on for a while, be ready for it to change: approach so that you can stop calmly.
strings.autodrom.8.name: Crossing an uncontrolled level crossing
strings.autodrom.8.goal: Stop before the crossing at the “Stop” line, wait, make sure it is safe and cross.
strings.autodrom.8.how.0: When you see the level crossing signs, reduce speed.
strings.autodrom.8.how.1: Stop before the “Stop” line: without touching it and no more than 1 m from it.
strings.autodrom.8.how.2: Wait for at least 3 seconds and look left and right.
strings.autodrom.8.how.3: Drive over the level crossing without stopping on the tracks. In a manual car, do not change gear while crossing the rails: this reduces the risk of stalling.
strings.autodrom.8.penalties.0: Touching or crossing the “Stop” line before stopping - penalty.
strings.autodrom.8.penalties.1: Stopping more than 1 m from the “Stop” line - penalty.
strings.autodrom.8.penalties.2: Moving off less than 3 seconds after stopping - penalty.
strings.autodrom.8.tip: In real driving, look both ways before any level crossing and never stop on the tracks.
strings.autodrom.9.name: Acceleration lane
strings.autodrom.9.goal: Over a short section, show acceleration with an upshift, and then slowing down with a downshift.
strings.autodrom.9.how.0: After the minimum speed sign, accelerate to above 20 km/h.
strings.autodrom.9.how.1: Manual: while accelerating, shift from first to second gear within the section.
strings.autodrom.9.how.2: Before the maximum speed limit sign, reduce speed to 20 km/h or below.
strings.autodrom.9.how.3: Manual: shift back from second to first before the end of the section.
strings.autodrom.9.how.4: Automatic: simply accelerate and brake according to the signs; the gearbox changes gear.
strings.autodrom.9.penalties.0: Manual: the required gear not selected within the set section - penalty, one of the most “expensive” mistakes under the test ground methodology.
strings.autodrom.9.penalties.1: Sign requirements not met: not accelerating above the minimum speed or not slowing to the maximum speed - penalty.
strings.autodrom.9.tip: Practise the 1-2 and 2-1 shifts until you can do them without looking at the lever. The section is short and there is no time to think.
strings.autodrom.10.name: Emergency stop
strings.autodrom.10.goal: Stop instantly at an unexpected signal in the cabin and mark the stop with the hazard warning lights.
strings.autodrom.10.how.0: Be ready in this section: your right foot must be able to move to the brake quickly.
strings.autodrom.10.how.1: When you hear the sound signal or see the light signal in the cabin, brake at once to a full stop. In a manual car, press the clutch too.
strings.autodrom.10.how.2: Immediately after stopping, switch on the hazard warning lights.
strings.autodrom.10.how.3: Before continuing, switch the hazard warning lights off and only then move off.
strings.autodrom.10.penalties.0: Not stopping immediately after the signal or switching on the hazard lights late - penalty (under the test ground methodology, only a few seconds are allowed for each action).
strings.autodrom.10.penalties.1: Moving off without switching off the hazard warning lights - penalty.
strings.autodrom.10.tip: Find the hazard lights button at the start, while you are adjusting the mirrors. When the signal comes, there will be no time to look for it.
strings.autodrom.11.name: Finish
strings.autodrom.11.goal: Complete the test correctly: signal a right turn, cross the finish line, stop and leave the car.
strings.autodrom.11.how.0: Before the finish line, switch on the right direction indicator.
strings.autodrom.11.how.1: Cross the finish line and stop at the indicated place.
strings.autodrom.11.how.4: Apply the handbrake and switch off the engine.
strings.autodrom.11.how.5: Unfasten your seat belt and get out of the car.
strings.autodrom.11.penalties.0: Right direction indicator not switched on before the finish line - penalty.
strings.autodrom.11.penalties.1: If you reach 100 penalty points along the way, you will not get to the finish: the test is stopped early.
strings.autodrom.11.tip: The test is not over until you have crossed the finish line. Many people lose points on the last metres because of a forgotten indicator.
strings.city.0.p.0: A correct seating position is not only about comfort. It lets you control the car faster and more precisely, and the seat belt and airbags protect you as designed.
strings.city.0.list.0: Seat: with the brake (or clutch) pedal fully pressed, your leg remains slightly bent at the knee.
strings.city.0.list.1: Backrest: if you stretch out your arm, your wrist rests on the top of the steering wheel while your shoulders stay against the backrest.
strings.city.0.list.2: Head restraint: its top is roughly level with the top of your head and close to the back of your head.
strings.city.0.list.3: Hands on the wheel at “9 and 3 o’clock”.
strings.city.0.list.4: Interior mirror: you can see the whole rear window.
strings.city.0.list.5: Side mirrors: only a narrow strip of your own bodywork is visible, with the horizon roughly in the middle.
strings.city.0.list.6: Seat belt: the lap part low across the hips, the shoulder part across the middle of the shoulder, without twists. You and all passengers must be belted (para. 9(5) of the Rules).
strings.city.1.p.0: This is the basic habit for any manoeuvre: moving off, changing lanes, turning, making a U-turn and stopping. The order is always the same, and in time it becomes automatic.
strings.city.1.p.1: Signal before you begin the manoeuvre (para. 47 of the Rules). But an indicator only announces your intention: it gives you no priority and does not relieve you of the need for caution ⟦36⟧.
strings.city.1.list.0: Mirror: who is behind and beside you, and how fast they are going.
strings.city.1.list.1: Signal: switch the indicator on early enough for others to notice it.
strings.city.1.list.2: Mirror again, and a quick glance over your shoulder into the blind spot.
strings.city.1.list.3: Manoeuvre: smoothly, without jerking the wheel.
strings.city.1.list.4: After the manoeuvre, check that the indicator has switched off.
strings.city.2.p.0: When changing lanes, you give way to those travelling in the same direction without changing lane. If two cars change lanes at the same time, the one on the left gives way (para. 51 of the Rules).
strings.city.2.list.0: Pick a “gap” in the next lane and adjust your speed to it. Usually you need to speed up slightly rather than brake.
strings.city.2.list.1: Change one lane at a time, checking the mirrors each time.
strings.city.2.list.2: Take the lane for your turn in advance: before a turn you must take the appropriate far left or far right position ⟦37⟧.
strings.city.2.list.3: If you see no “gap”, it is better to drive on and turn round later than to squeeze in.
strings.city.2.list.4: Do not stay long next to another vehicle’s rear wing: there you are in its blind spot.
strings.city.3.p.0: A left turn is one of the most dangerous manoeuvres in town. When turning left or making a U-turn on a green signal, you give way to oncoming vehicles going straight or turning right (para. 95 of the Rules). At an intersection of roads of equal status the same rule applies ⟦38⟧, and you also give way to those approaching from the right ⟦39⟧.
strings.city.3.p.1: When turning in any direction, you give way to pedestrians crossing the road you are turning into ⟦40⟧.
strings.city.3.list.0: While you wait for a chance to turn, keep your wheels straight. If you are hit from behind, the car will not be pushed into the oncoming lane.
strings.city.3.list.1: Assess not only the first oncoming car but also those who may appear from behind it in the adjacent lane.
strings.city.3.list.2: Do not enter the intersection if there is a traffic jam beyond it and you would get stuck there ⟦41⟧.
strings.city.3.list.3: An amber signal does not mean “I’ll make it”, it means “I prepare to stop”.
strings.city.3.list.4: As you turn, take one more look at the pedestrian crossing at the last moment.
strings.city.4.p.0: Roundabouts in Kazakhstan’s cities can be large and multi-lane. The main thing is to work out in advance who gives way to whom: look at the priority signs before the entrance, where most often there is the “Give way” sign.
strings.city.4.list.0: Slow down before entering and find a gap in the traffic.
strings.city.4.list.1: If your exit is close, keep to the right lane; if it is far, or you are making a U-turn, take your lane in advance according to the markings and signs.
strings.city.4.list.2: Inside the roundabout, watch the cars on your right and left: many change lanes at the last moment.
strings.city.4.list.3: Before your exit, switch on the right indicator and move to the right in advance.
strings.city.4.list.4: If you miss your exit, go round once more, and do not brake on the roundabout.
strings.city.5.p.0: At an uncontrolled crossing, you give way to pedestrians crossing the road (para. 106 of the Rules). If a car in the adjacent lane has stopped before the crossing, continue only after making sure there are no people beyond it ⟦42⟧.
strings.city.5.list.0: Approaching a crossing, take your foot off the accelerator and watch the pavements, not just the crossing itself.
strings.city.5.list.1: Always let a pedestrian with a white cane cross ⟦43⟧.
strings.city.5.list.2: Near stops, schools, markets and shopping centres, people appear unexpectedly, including away from crossings.
strings.city.5.list.3: In winter, pedestrians in hoods hear and see poorly, and on ice they cannot stop quickly.
strings.city.5.list.4: In the evening, people in dark clothes are seen very late: slow down near crossings.
strings.city.6.p.0: In built-up areas, you give way to buses and trolleybuses moving off from a marked stop (para. 127 of the Rules). You must not drive or stop in a lane for route vehicles, except in cases the Rules allow, for example to turn ⟦44⟧.
strings.city.6.list.0: When passing a stationary bus, remember that someone may step out from behind it. Give way to those walking to or from the bus ⟦45⟧.
strings.city.6.list.1: A bus has switched on its left indicator at a stop: let it pull out.
strings.city.6.list.2: Taxis and cars with passengers stop suddenly: keep your distance and do not tailgate.
strings.city.6.list.3: Do not overtake a bus on the right at a stop.
strings.city.6.list.4: Near vehicles displaying the “Carriage of children” sign, slow down and let children pass ⟦46⟧.
strings.city.7.p.0: At night you see less and later. Choose your speed according to visibility (para. 72 of the Rules).
strings.city.7.list.0: Switch from main beam to dipped headlights at least 150 m before an oncoming car, and always when the main beam could dazzle others ⟦47⟧.
strings.city.7.list.1: If you are dazzled, switch on the hazard warning lights and, without changing lane, stop ⟦48⟧.
strings.city.7.list.2: Do not look straight at oncoming headlights, look towards the right edge of the road.
strings.city.7.list.3: Keep your headlights and windows clean, including on the inside: dirt increases glare.
strings.city.7.list.4: If you are tired, driving at night is twice as dangerous. Stop and rest.
strings.city.8.p.0: The first minutes of rain are the slipperiest: water mixes with dust and oil on the asphalt. Braking distance gets longer and visibility gets worse.
strings.city.8.list.0: Slow down smoothly and increase your following distance to 3-4 seconds.
strings.city.8.list.1: Switch on dipped headlights so that you can be seen.
strings.city.8.list.2: If the windows mist up, turn on the windscreen demister and, if necessary, the air conditioning.
strings.city.8.list.3: Avoid deep puddles if it is safe, or drive through them slowly: there may be a pothole in the puddle.
strings.city.8.list.4: If the steering feels light and the car “floats”, that is aquaplaning: ease off the accelerator smoothly, hold the wheel straight and do not brake hard.
strings.city.9.p.0: In many regions of Kazakhstan winter is long: severe frosts, blizzards and snowdrifts on highways, and black ice when the temperature is around zero. In winter the car brakes worse and skids easily.
strings.city.9.p.1: You must not mix studded and non-studded tyres, or frost-resistant and non-frost-resistant tyres, on the same axle ⟦49⟧. Winter tyres grip noticeably better in cold and snow.
strings.city.9.list.0: Before setting off, clear snow and ice from all windows, mirrors, headlights and the roof.
strings.city.9.list.1: Make every action smooth: accelerator, brake, steering. Sudden movements on ice almost always lead to a skid.
strings.city.9.list.2: Following distance: several times more than in summer.
strings.city.9.list.3: Black ice appears first on bridges, flyovers, in the shade and near water.
strings.city.9.list.4: On an empty stretch with no cars behind you, brake lightly to feel how slippery it is.
strings.city.9.list.5: If the rear axle skids, steer in the direction of the skid and straighten the wheels as soon as the car starts to go straight.
strings.city.9.list.6: On a highway in a blizzard, traffic may be organised in a convoy: the convoy leader sets the speed and distance, and overtaking inside the convoy is not allowed (Chapter 26 of the Rules).
strings.city.9.list.7: Do not go out on the highway in a snowstorm unless absolutely necessary. Take warm clothes, water and a full tank.
strings.city.10.p.0: Until you have your licence, you may drive on roads only with an instructor (para. 147 of the Rules). So your first solo drives are a separate stage, and it is worth preparing for it.
strings.city.10.list.0: Start with familiar routes and quiet times: weekend mornings, not the rush hour.
strings.city.10.list.1: Plan your route in advance and set up the navigation before you start driving.
strings.city.10.list.2: It is handy to make the first drives with an experienced driver beside you, who will advise you without fussing.
strings.city.10.list.3: Phone in a holder, calls only through a headset or hands-free ⟦50⟧.
strings.city.10.list.4: Do not give in to horns behind you and do not try to “keep up with the flow”. Your speed is the one at which you control everything.
strings.city.10.list.5: Try difficult situations (narrow yards, parking at shopping centres, multi-lane interchanges) at quiet times first.
strings.city.11.p.0: Anyone can stall, especially in a manual car. It is unpleasant but not dangerous if you act calmly.
strings.city.11.list.0: Press the brake, press the clutch, select neutral.
strings.city.11.list.1: On a slope, apply the handbrake so that you do not roll back.
strings.city.11.list.2: Start the engine and move off as usual, without hurrying.
strings.city.11.list.3: If you cannot restart quickly, switch on the hazard warning lights to warn others.
strings.city.11.list.4: At an intersection, ignore horns behind you: a couple of extra seconds are better than a new mistake.
strings.city.11.list.5: If you stall on a level crossing, immediately get the passengers out and clear the crossing by any means.
strings.checklists.beforeExam.0: Bring your ID: you are identified by it and by biometrics.
strings.checklists.beforeExam.1: Check the date, time and address of the specialised PSC in eGov or the app. Arrive early.
strings.checklists.beforeExam.2: Medical examination on Form 073/u completed and shown in the system.
strings.checklists.beforeExam.3: Do several full tests against the clock: 40 questions in 40 minutes, no more than 8 mistakes.
strings.checklists.beforeExam.4: Study the diagram of your specialised PSC’s test ground and the order of the exercises.
strings.checklists.beforeExam.5: Go over the reference points for parking and turning round with your instructor.
strings.checklists.beforeExam.6: Get enough sleep and do not take medicines that slow your reactions.
strings.checklists.beforeExam.7: Comfortable shoes with thin soles: not heels, flip-flops or heavy boots.
strings.checklists.beforeExam.8: Do not take your phone or headphones into the exam room.
strings.checklists.beforeExam.9: In the car at the test ground, before the “Start” command: seat, head restraint, mirrors, seat belt, find the hazard lights button and the indicators.
strings.checklists.beforeExam.10: Remember: one failure is not the end. The first retake is scheduled for the very next working day.
strings.checklists.beforeDrive.0: Walk around the car: tyres without cuts or bulges, pressure correct, tread at least 1.6 mm ⟦51⟧.
strings.checklists.beforeDrive.1: No fresh puddles of oil or fluid under the car.
strings.checklists.beforeDrive.2: Clean windows, mirrors and headlights. In winter, free of snow and ice, including the roof.
strings.checklists.beforeDrive.3: Headlights, brake lights and indicators work.
strings.checklists.beforeDrive.4: Carry your licence and the vehicle registration certificate (para. 9(1) of the Rules).
strings.checklists.beforeDrive.5: Seat, head restraint and mirrors adjusted; you and all passengers are belted ⟦52⟧.
strings.checklists.beforeDrive.6: Phone in a holder, route set in the navigation before you start driving.
strings.checklists.beforeDrive.7: Enough fuel and washer fluid; in winter, a non-freezing type.
strings.checklists.beforeDrive.8: The car has a warning triangle, a first aid kit and a fire extinguisher.
strings.checklists.beforeDrive.9: You are rested, well and sober ⟦53⟧.
strings.checklists.beforeDrive.10: Leave with time to spare, so that you do not have to rush.
